verdict.rationale: Netlify documents an official "Netlify SDK" for building extensions and integrations, and shows in-code platform primitives such as `getStore` for Blobs, so official SDKs do exist. However, the evidence only covers extension building and a single storage snippet, not general-purpose client SDKs for automating the platform; the REST API is documented, but the OpenAPI probe returned 404s. missing for 10: official language client SDKs for the REST API, a published OpenAPI spec for SDK generation, in-depth SDK reference docs or language coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Build extensions and custom integrations with the Netlify SDK to enhance workflows, add UI components, and connect third-party services.
